title: 第一卷 第23章 大小姐是您自己扑上来的第一卷 第24章 在轿子里
slug: 逆主马奴我以阴阳证大道
lines: 这一次，秦明岚没有被动地跟着王龙的动作走，而是主动去感受那股力量的传递路径。
她能感觉到他的手掌贴在自己腰侧，五指微微收紧。
秦明岚咬了咬嘴唇，将这些杂念抛到脑后，专注于手中的竹枝。
“准备好了吗？”
王龙的声音在耳边响起。
“出剑。”
王龙握着她的手，再次向前一送。
嗤！
又是一道剑气，比刚才更细、更快，飞出去四丈远，在院墙上留下第二个孔洞。
秦明岚的眼睛亮了起来。
“再来！”
“再来！”
“再来！”
一遍又一遍，秦明岚不知疲倦地练着。
王龙也不厌其烦地握着她的手，一遍一遍地纠正她的姿势，引导她的力量。
两人的身体贴在一起，他的手始终揽着她的腰，掌心滚烫。
秦明岚渐渐习惯了这种亲密的接触，不再像一开始那样僵硬。
她全部的注意力都放在了剑上，放在了那股从脚底升起到指尖的力量上。
她太想变强了。
变强才能保护嫂子跟侄女，保护侯府。
那些虎视眈眈的豺狼，那些觊觎侯府的势力，随时都可能扑上来。
她不能等，也不能靠别人。
她必须自己变强。
“大小姐，这次您自己试试。”
王龙松开手，恭敬地退到一旁。
秦明岚深吸一口气，双脚分开与肩同宽，膝盖微曲，腰身下沉。
她的脑海中回放着刚才的感觉。
脚底发力，传到腰，腰传到肩，肩传到臂，臂传到腕……
秦明岚一声清喝，竹枝向前刺出。
一道微弱的剑气从竹枝尖端激射而出，虽然只有三尺来长，维持了一息就消散，是她自己凝出的剑气！
秦明岚愣住了。
她盯着竹枝尖端那一缕尚未散尽的灵气，眼眶忽然红了。
“本小姐……本小姐做到了……”
她的声音在发抖，带着压抑不住的激动。
content_en:
This time, Qin Minglan did not passively follow Wang Long's movements, but took the initiative to feel the transmission path of the power.
She could feel his palms pressing against her waist, his fingers tightening slightly.
Qin Minglan bit her lip, put these distracting thoughts behind her, and focused on the bamboo branch in her hand.
"Are you ready?"
Wang Long's voice rang in his ears.
"Yeah."
"Draw out the sword."
Wang Long held her hand and moved it forward again.
laugh!
Another sword energy, thinner and faster than before, flew four feet away, leaving a second hole in the courtyard wall.
Qin Minglan's eyes lit up.
"Come again!"
"Come again!"
"Come again!"
Over and over again, Qin Minglan practiced tirelessly.
Wang Lung also took the trouble to hold her hand, correcting her posture and guiding her strength over and over again.
Their bodies were pressed together, and his hands were always around her waist, his palms hot.
Qin Minglan gradually got used to this kind of close contact and was no longer as stiff as at the beginning.
All her attention was on the sword, on the power rising from the soles of her feet to her fingertips.
She wanted to become stronger so much.
Only by becoming stronger can you protect your sister-in-law and niece, and protect the Hou Mansion.
Those coveting wolves, those forces coveting the Hou Mansion, may pounce at any time.
She couldn't wait or rely on others.
She had to become stronger on her own.
"Miss, you try it yourself this time."
Wang Lung let go of his hand and stepped aside respectfully.
Qin Minglan took a deep breath, placed her feet shoulder-width apart, slightly bent her knees, and lowered her waist.
The feeling just now replayed in her mind.
The force from the soles of the feet is transmitted to the waist, the waist is transmitted to the shoulders, the shoulders are transmitted to the arms, the arms are transmitted to the wrists...
"Ha!"
Qin Minglan shouted loudly, and the bamboo branches thrust forward.
A weak sword energy shot out from the tip of the bamboo branch. Although it was only three feet long, it dissipated after one breath. It was the sword energy she had condensed herself!
Qin Minglan was stunned.
She stared at the strand of spiritual energy at the tip of the bamboo branch that had not yet dissipated, and her eyes suddenly turned red.
"Miss...I did it..."
Her voice was trembling with uncontrollable excitement.
